<thought>Based on the molecular formula (C11H3O4Cl), DBE, and NMR data, the molecule consists of a fully substituted aromatic ring bearing a chlorine atom, a methoxy group (the only source of hydrogens), and additional oxygen atoms that are part of ether linkages without hydrogens. The simplest way to represent the fragments that can be joined to reconstruct the molecule is the chlorobenzene core and the methoxy fragment.</thought>
<final_answer>['c1ccc(Cl)cc1', 'CO']</final_answer>
